stem: Based on information in the excerpt from "Big Wheels Keep on Turnin'," which statement best captures a way that society views new technologies?

options.label: A
options.text: People associate new technologies with high production costs, which prevents many people from developing their ideas.

options.label: B
options.text: People typically see new technologies as sources of disagreement between groups of people.

options.label: C
options.text: People often struggle to understand what new technologies will be like before experiencing them firsthand.

options.label: D
options.text: People usually consider the ways that new technologies can interfere with productivity.
